news.headline: Crypto platform Gemini’s stock is down 80% from its IPO. That’s reviving takeover speculation
Visa Moves to Close Meme Coin Credit Card Rewards Loophole
news.summary: Visa is closing a loophole that let cardholders rack up rewards on meme coin purchases by classifying them as digital media. The move comes after banks failed to secure broader stablecoin restrictions through the Clarity Act, handing JP Morgan a more limited but still meaningful victory in the ongoing fight over crypto card rewards.

educational.title: What a Recession Actually Means (And What It Doesn't)
points: A recession is broadly defined as a significant decline in economic activity
It's not the same as a stock market crash — they can happen independently
Recessions typically bring rising unemployment and falling consumer spending
They're a normal part of economic cycles, not a rare catastrophe
Historically, markets have recovered from every recession, though timing varies
